item.title: Singapore: A Strategic Regional Gateway for Frontier AI Companies
item.description: Minister Josephine Teo highlights Singapore’s dynamic market, growing talent ecosystem, supportive research focus and strong infrastructure as key factors attracting frontier AI companies to Southeast Asia.

item.title: India: Establishing a Strong, Inclusive National AI Ecosystem
item.description: India’s US$1.25 billion IndiaAI Mission is rapidly expanding shared compute, indigenous models, talent development and trusted governance to build an inclusive, nationwide artificial intelligence ecosystem.

item.title: Indonesia: Danantara Invests in an Industrial and Digital Future
item.description: Indonesia’s sovereign wealth fund Danantara plans to invest US$13.1 billion in four major projects in 2026, boosting jobs, digital infrastructure, industrial growth and long-term national economic resilience.

item.title: Singapore: Scaling AI Responsibly with Trust, Talent and Innovation
item.description: Singapore is advancing responsible AI adoption by pairing trusted governance, strong talent development and public sector innovation to scale experimentation safely across the wider economy.

item.title: Malaysia: 5G Smart Poles Power Terengganu’s Smart City Services
item.description: The 5G intelligent pole pilot in Terengganu integrates IoT sensors, EV charging and real-time data systems to enhance smart city services and strengthen sustainable urban infrastructure.

item.title: New Zealand, Singapore Launch e-Certification to Boost Digital Trade
item.description: The countries have transformed trade in food and primary products through e-certification under their Strategic Partnership, boosting efficiency, supply chain security and tech-driven collaboration.

item.title: Australia: NSW Launches New AI Governance Framework
item.description: The New South Wales Government has launched a redesigned Artificial Intelligence Assessment Framework to streamline public sector AI oversight, manage risks, and align governance with emerging technologies.

item.title: India: Championing Ethical, Inclusive and Global AI Innovation
item.description: India is positioning itself as a global AI leader through the India AI Impact Summit 2026, combining citizen-driven ethical AI pledges, cutting-edge global innovation challenges and investment in talent and infrastructure.

item.title: Hong Kong: PolyU, UM Launch Joint Robotics and AI Laboratory
item.description: PolyU and UM establish a jointly funded robotics laboratory and dual PhD programme to advance embodied intelligence and autonomous systems research.

item.title: Vietnam: Driving Digital Transformation for Global Competitiveness
item.description: Vietnam’s Resolution 57 is driving local innovation, digital transformation and science-led reforms to strengthen governance, competitiveness and sustainable economic growth nationwide.
